Why Data Science

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
Orientation day on campus.


In the first week of MDS we had 3 days of orientation. This included many workshops on program policies, mental health, and career advising. It was also a great chance to get to know other students in the program. We completed a fun campus goose chase, which can be seen in the photo!
The following week we started all of our classes. It has been very busy and has required a lot of time management and organization but I am beginning to get to grips with the demands of the program. I am really enjoying what I am learning and I was surprised by how quickly I made friends in the program.
